name: The Map Wall (Đồ Bích)

bonuses.rule: Each Ask mark on the foe raises your next The Blade Answers cut's crit damage by 10 %; a The Blade Answers cut that spends 5 or more Ask marks ignores half of the foe's ward shields (bypass 0.5, the engine's bypass_cap).

story: The hunter's sword with its 412 notches and the coat that carries the map wall's caves: what the Tiêu son took with him when the hermitage turned him away.
